title: Uruguayan Empanadas with Aromatic Filling
description: Delicious vegetarian empanadas filled with a flavorful and aromatic mixture of sautéed onions, bell peppers, and spices. Perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the chopped onions and bell peppers until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground aromatic and score to the skillet and stir to combine.
Roll out the empanadas according to package instructions.
Place a spoonful of the onion and bell pepper mixture onto one half of each empanada.
Fold the other half over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little water.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
